name: Feature request
about: Suggest a change to KiteGlance
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []

---

## What you want

A short description of the proposed behaviour.

## Why

The motivation. What problem does this solve? Who is the audience?
A line on the trade-off (what the feature costs in code surface
area, performance, or UX) helps a maintainer decide.

## Alternatives considered

What else did you look at? Did you try the Windows build, or a
different widget, or working around the gap with a script? Knowing
what was tried saves the maintainer from re-deriving it.

## Sketch (optional)

A mock-up, a SwiftUI snippet, a one-liner of pseudocode. Not all
proposals need a sketch; a paragraph is fine.

## Notes

Anything else.
